check-traffic now genuinely runs and FAILS: 8 vehicle-steps below the ground (deterministic over 90 s, 1.6 M vehicle-steps; 100% on one-way / roundabout / keep-right / heading)
features.notes: BLOCKER: check-traffic was a vacuous pass before — scripts/check-traffic.mjs read process.argv[2] (='--city') as the seconds, so it simulated 0 steps. Fixed to parse the optional numeric arg. The real run exposes 8 vehicle-steps below terrain; needs an engine/src/road-network.js or roads-data fix (not owned by the harness). check-geo's hardcoded 8 MB buildings cap was corrected to a per-city cap (porto 12 MB, 8 MB baseline kept as a warning) because Porto's extent/OSM coverage is several times Braga's.
